description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber and Lotus Field by tapping them, adding {G}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, targeting Scrivener.
Ivy triggers, copying Snap, targeting Ivy.
Resolve the copy of Snap, returning Ivy from the battlefield to your hand and untapping Simic Growth Chamber and Lotus Field.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber and Lotus Field by tapping them, adding {G}{U} and three mana of any color.
Resolve Snap, returning Scrivener from the battlefield to your hand and untapping Simic Growth Chamber and Lotus Field.
Cast Ivy by paying {G}{U}.
Cast Scrivener by paying {4}{U}.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Snap from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
